sources.snippet: Sana_Sprint_0.6B_1024px_diffusers ... 🐱 Sana Model Card Demos Training Pipeline Model Efficiency SANA-Sprint is an ultra-efficient diffusion model for text-to-image (T2I) generation, reducing inference steps from 20 to 1-4 while achieving state-of-the-art performance.

sources.title: SANA-Sprint - nvlabs.github.io
sources.snippet: (2) SANA-Sprint is a unified step-adaptive model that achieves high-quality generation in 1-4 steps, eliminating step-specific training and improving efficiency. (3) We integrate ControlNet with SANA-Sprint for real-time interactive image generation, enabling instant visual feedback for user interaction.
